definitions.explanation: A train service that stops at every station on the line. Short for {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}.

examples.japanese: {各停|かくてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各停|かくてい}しか⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Only local trains stop at this station.

examples.japanese: {各停|かくてい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{座|すわ}れる→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: The local takes longer, but you can get a seat.

notes:
{各停|かくてい} is an abbreviation of ⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧ (stopping at each station).

TRAIN SERVICE HIERARCHY:
- {各停|かくてい}/⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: local (slowest, all stops)
- ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧: rapid
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧: express
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express (fastest)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各停|かくてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take a local train
- {各停|かくてい}しか⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: only locals stop
- {各停|かくてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go by local train

USAGE:
- Also called ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ on some lines
- Sometimes advantageous for getting a seat on crowded lines
